title: Liability Size Points for Insured Payoffs — Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
**Rule.** On an insured Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account paid off in full, the account's liability postings of every liability source are totalled: a total of at least 2500.00 USD adds 2 percentage points to the insured payoff discount percent, a total of at least 1000.00 but below 2500.00 adds 1 percentage point, and a smaller total adds none.

| Liability postings, all sources | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| at least 2500.00 | 2 |
| at least 1000.00, below 2500.00 | 1 |
| below 1000.00 | none |

The total takes in every patient-liability posting on the account (deductible, coinsurance, copay, non-covered service, coverage terminated or any other source), as posted, before any discount or payment.

## Edges (hypothetical totals)

- 2500.00: 2 points; 2499.99: 1 point.
- 1000.00: 1 point; 999.99: none.
- Deductible 700.00 and coinsurance 400.00 total 1100.00: 1 point.
